task_completion.description: Navigate to the Workflow creation page in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Workflow' module open with a 'Create Workflow' form or edit view visible.

task_completion.description: Set the Workflow Name, Module, and Status correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Workflow Name' field contains 'Auto-Qualify High-Value Prospects', 'Workflow Module' is set to 'Opportunities', and 'Status' is 'Active'.
The 'Run' dropdown is set to 'Always' and 'Run On' is set to 'All Records'.

task_completion.description: Add a condition for the Opportunity Amount.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A condition row showing the field 'Amount', operator 'Greater Than or Equal To', and value '50000'.

task_completion.description: Add a condition for the Sales Stage.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A condition row showing the field 'Sales Stage', operator 'Equal To', and value 'Prospecting'.

task_completion.description: Add a 'Modify Record' action to update the Sales Stage.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An Action block named 'Advance to Qualification' with 'Select Action' set to 'Modify Record', and a field mapping setting 'Sales Stage' to 'Qualification'.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with SuiteCRM form fields and dropdowns.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to run SQL queries to insert the workflow rule directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal logs (if visible) do not show SQL 'INSERT' statements or direct file edits to the SuiteCRM database.

integrity.description: The agent actually clicks the 'Save' button to commit the workflow.
integrity.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the 'Save' button being clicked or a 'Success' message/Detail View of the saved workflow.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The workflow must be named 'Auto-Qualify High-Value Prospects' for the 'Opportunities' module. Status must be 'Active'. Conditions: Amount >= 50000 AND Sales Stage = 'Prospecting'. Action: 'Modify Record' named 'Advance to Qualification' setting Sales Stage to 'Qualification'. Run settings: 'Always' on 'All Records'.
